statement: During a Pi-driven extraction, agents cannot write or edit coverage ledger files directly; review entries are accepted and persisted through feynman_reviewed.
consequence: Unverified or improperly formed review records cannot bypass the read-evidence and anchor checks through Pi's write/edit tools.

enforcedAt.trigger: Pi write or edit tool call while extraction is active

frames.note: Blocks paths within the model coverage directory.
Writes accepted review entries via recordReviewed after checking tracked paths, read evidence, and anchors.
